title: His father's discipline and flute playing
summary: Howard says his father told him to behave and played flute, but did not teach him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I certainly would. My father didn't bother. My father was -- he was -- wait a minute.

My father, he never bothered about nothing like that. He just say, 'Paul now you stop that. You behave yourself.' I didn't pay attention to him. We'd just get out and if I'd get out there and get to fussing and fighting that would be all there was to it.
One more point about your father, he was a musician too.
What did he play again? 'Cause I know I talked to you about that.
He played a flute. He played another instrument, I'm trying to think of it. You know, you get the instrument and older people, it's nothing like I was playing, but he played.
Did he do any teaching for you, and your brother?
Not for me. Neither one of us. But he was around when the teachers were.
